news.analysis: Jones continued his trend of putrid play. There's no sugar coating it. The Colts won because the Dolphins were starting their backup QB, not because of anything Jones did. Had it been anyone else, we'd be talking about a loss. You have to wonder how much longer the coaching staff can continue trotting out Jones, who has been hampering this offense all season.
news.contents: Daniel Jones completed 11 of 22 passes for 108 yards, a touchdown, and two picks in the Colts' 24-22 win over Miami.
news.title: Daniel Jones has putrid performance in win over Dolphins

news.contents: Indianapolis Colts quarterback Daniel Jones put together another stinker in Week 10, completing 11-of-22 passes (50%) for 108 yards and one touchdown, while throwing two interceptions. He added nine yards on five carries, but his rushing has been limited to a fantasy point or two each week, and none of his rushes have been worth much, as shown by his 2.9 YPC mark, the lowest of his eight-year career. Over the past two weeks, Jones had a chance to right the ship with matchups against Dallas and ...
news.title: Daniel Jones Continues to Struggle, Emerging as a Fantasy Drop Candidate

news.analysis: Jones Sr. has cooled off out of the backfield of late, recording under 100 offensive yards in each of his last four contests. The running back remains difficult to trust while sharing backfield work with Jordan Mason for the Vikings ahead of a Week 11 matchup against the San Francisco 49ers.
news.contents: Aaron Jones Sr. rushed 11 times for 47 yards and one touchdown while also hauling in his only target for eight yards in the Vikings' 30-10 Week 10 win over the Packers.
news.title: Aaron Jones Sr. reaches end zone in Week 10 win over Packers

news.analysis: Price was able to score a touchdown for the first time in his career. He continues to look like the 1B in the backfield for Seattle with Zach Charbonnet as the 1A. Price remains a steady flex option.
news.contents: Jadarian Price ran for 36 yards and a touchdown on nine carries in the Seahawks 21-13 win over the Raiders. He also caught his lone target for eight yards receiving.
news.title: Jadarian Price finds the end zone Sunday

news.contents: Seattle Seahawks running back Jadarian Price totaled nine carries, 36 rushing yards, and a rushing touchdown during Sunday's Week 10 win over the Las Vegas Raiders. He also converted his lone target into an eight-yard reception. As Zach Charbonnet continues to take on more volume and occupy the lead-back role, Price has seen less involvement on offense. Sunday's 10 touches were his second-lowest mark of the season, albeit over just six games. When he was coming out of college just over six ...
news.title: Jadarian Price Makes Up for Modest Role with a Touchdown

news.analysis: It was a low volume day for Kamara, but he made the most of it with two touchdowns. His role was considered up in the air with Travis Etienne returning and Audric Estime playing well, but the veteran was able to produce when it mattered Sunday. Kamara and the Saints will take on the Bears in Week 11 .
news.contents: Alvin Kamara rushed for four yards and a touchdown on two carries in a 20-17 loss to the Panthers. He caught 3-of-4 targets for 10 yards and a touchdown.
news.title: Alvin Kamara finds the end zone in Week 10

news.analysis: Williams finished second on the team in targets in the lopsided win while hitting at least 50 receiving yards for the fourth time over his past six contests. He will be a boom/bust WR3 for fantasy heading into Week 11 vs. the Buccaneers.

news.analysis: Kelce was hampered by a lingering ankle injury, exiting briefly on his way to finishing with less than four receptions for the first time in his last five games. The tight end will look to get back on track against the Arizona Cardinals in Week 11.
news.contents: Travis Kelce hauled in both of his targets for 30 yards in the Chiefs' 35-13 win over the Falcons in Week 10.
news.title: Travis Kelce quiet in Week 10 win

news.contents: Kansas City Chiefs tight end Travis Kelce (ankle) returned to Sunday's Week 10 game against the Atlanta Falcons after leaving with an ankle injury, according to Matt McMullen. Kelce's only catch before exiting went for 23 yards on Kansas City's opening drive and ended with a tackle by DeMarcco Hellams. Kelce went to the locker room and was initially listed as questionable to return. Fellow Chiefs tight end Jared Wiley was ruled out with an ankle injury.
news.title: Travis Kelce Returns Against Falcons After Ankle Injury

Harris stepped up in the absence of teammate Ladd McConkey (back) to lead the team in each significant receiving category on a night when LA recorded its first win of the season. It's by no means a week-winning output, but strong production considering quarterback Justin Herbert tossed for a mere 129 yards on 18 pass ...

news.analysis: Most of Jeudy's production Sunday came on a season-long 65-yard gain late in the second quarter. The veteran receiver has now caught multiple passes in six of the last seven games, but he's topped out at four. Overall, Jeudy has 20 receptions at just over 14 yards per with no touchdowns through 10 games.
